payload.summary: Check whether Doppler holds a stale RAILWAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET that could overwrite the 2026-09-26 rotation
payload.detail: The Database service in Railway production carries DOPPLER_CONFIG, DOPPLER_ENVIRONMENT and DOPPLER_PROJECT, which suggests Doppler may sync secrets into Railway. RAILWAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET was rotated directly in Railway on 2026-09-26 (#B6JP6F) because the old value could not be read. If Doppler holds the old value and syncs, the next sync would silently break the deploy-failure alarm again, which is the same shape as the original fault. Next action (owner, about 2 minutes): copy RAILWAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET from Railway, Database service, Variables, into Doppler if Doppler has that key; otherwise confirm Doppler does not manage it and close this. No Doppler connector is available to agents in cloud sessions. Verify afterwards with Railway test-webhook (expect 200).
payload.source: Railway connector read of Database service variable names, 2026-09-26, session claude/review-assessment-4s1w86
